name: 上班摸鱼
tagline: 摸鱼中 老板来了 我先溜了

stickers.caption: 摸鱼中
stickers.action: Starts seated in an office chair, one hand on the keyboard and the other hiding a phone under the desk. She side-eyes, thumb-scrolls the phone with a small grin and one sweat drop, then looks back at the monitor and settles into the same seated pose.

stickers.caption: 老板来了
stickers.action: Starts standing at the desk with a phone in both hands, feet planted. She flinches, stuffs the phone behind her back, fake-types with a stiff smile and one sweat drop, then brings the phone forward and returns to the same standing pose.

stickers.caption: 带薪发呆
stickers.action: Starts lying flat on her back on the office floor, arms loose, eyes unfocused. A tiny star blinks once above her; she sighs, the star fades, and she stays lying in the same pose.

stickers.caption: 到点了！
stickers.action: Starts standing beside the desk, watching a small clock. She jumps up with both feet and arms thrown high, a few tiny stars pop, she lands, and she settles back into the same standing pose grinning.

stickers.caption: 信号不好
stickers.action: Starts standing facing forward, phone held at her chest. She turns her back to the camera, lifts the phone as if searching for signal, peeks over her shoulder with a sly smile and one sweat drop, then turns to face front again.

stickers.caption: 一起摸鱼
stickers.action: Starts seated facing the pink piglet on the desk. They quietly fist-bump, duck together behind the monitor to peek at a phone, a tiny star pops, then both rise back to the same face-to-face seated pose.

stickers.caption: 我先溜了
stickers.action: Starts standing by the desk, glancing left and right. She tiptoes, then sprints so her whole body leaves the frame completely; after a short empty beat she slides back in and stops in the same standing pose, still looking around.

stickers.caption: 别睡了
stickers.action: Starts standing over the pink piglet asleep on the keyboard, one palm raised. She pats the top of its head rapidly four or five times, light and cute, with a small yellow tick on each pat; the piglet squishes and blinks, then drops back to sleep as her hand returns to the raised start.
